name: Membership Query Complexity of the Three-Code Class
proof: Every coordinate has one label value shared by two of $000,011,101$, so one membership query cannot always identify the target; this is checked in $\texttt{sync/verify\_properness\_separation.py}$. Query $x_0$ first. If its label is zero the target is $000$; otherwise query $x_1$, which distinguishes $011$ from $101$. Thus two queries are necessary and sufficient.
